title: Design System: Retail Observatory — Soft Studio

extensions.sourceAuthority: src/studio.css overrides src/styles.css; chart colors live in src/components.tsx and src/pages.tsx.
extensions.rampPolicy: Eight-step dark-to-light OKLCH ramps are derived reference extensions from the normative role colors. They are not additional implemented CSS tokens. Preserve observed colors rather than substituting a ramp step.

metric.purpose: Dominant tabular numbers; explicit responsive long-value variants.

shadows.name: workspace
shadows.purpose: Inset desktop shell; removed on mobile.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Search/select focus-within halo paired with border.

motion.name: control-state
motion.value: background 180ms, color 180ms, box-shadow 220ms var(--ease-out), transform 180ms var(--ease-out)

motion.name: nav-indicator
motion.purpose: Measured selection travels behind stable nav buttons. Width is a bounded intentional transition on an absolutely positioned element, with no page-layout effects.

motion.name: page-arrival
motion.value: studio-arrive 300ms var(--ease-out); opacity .74 to 1; translateY(7px) to 0

motion.name: popover-arrival
motion.value: popover-in 220ms var(--ease-out); opacity .65 to 1; translateY(-5px) scale(.99) to identity

motion.name: refresh-sweep
motion.purpose: Indeterminate activity only; never a percent.

motion.name: hidden-document
motion.purpose: Pause spinner, shimmer, chart sweep, dots and refresh sweep while hidden.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: No animations or transitions; sheen hidden; dots/static sweep remain visible.
motion.purpose: Zero looping animation, including pseudo-elements; instant nav scrolling.

loadingContract.initial: Structural skeleton reflects real pending requests; no fabricated data, percentages or minimum duration.
loadingContract.refresh: Label exact previous market/date scope, retain data at opacity .55 and mark it inert/aria-busy. Keep filters available for interruption.
loadingContract.slow: After 5000ms, update status copy only; never delay ready results.
loadingContract.requests: Abort interrupted requests and ignore stale responses; retry visible errors.
loadingContract.reducedMotion: Zero loops; static status remains understandable.

accessibility.focus: 2px solid #7862c7; outline-offset:4px; fields also use focus-within halo.
accessibility.status: Polite loading/refresh live regions; skeleton aria-hidden; retained previous results inert and busy.
accessibility.labels: Skip link, aria-current navigation, labelled filters/heat cells, accessible Export CSV name when icon-only.
accessibility.readability: Tooltip body/labels use #6c5f7a; refresh caption uses #6c537e. Preserve labels alongside color.

chartBehavior.customerScatter: Positive log domains and explicit frequency/spend tick arrays; preserve logarithmic scale label.
chartBehavior.mobileMetrics: Sparks hide at 1260px and below to preserve readable values.

components.css: .ds-refresh{font-family:'DM Sans Variable','DM Sans',sans-serif;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#e8ddf4;border-radius:18px;padding:15px 18px 17px;color:#634578}.ds-refresh strong{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:550}.ds-refresh>span{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#6c537e}.ds-progress{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:3px;background:#dfd1ef;overflow:hidden}.ds-progress i{position:absolute;width:36%;height:100%;background:#b295cd;border-radius:3px;animation:ds-progress-sweep 1.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite}.ds-paused .ds-progress i{animation-play-state:paused}@keyframes ds-progress-sweep{from{transform:translateX(-110%)}to{transform:translateX(390%)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-progress i{width:100%;opacity:.55}}

narrative.overview:
A mature, approachable workspace for serious retail analysis. Lilac, blush and sky surfaces make information welcoming; charcoal text, restrained symbols and real charts keep it credible. Rounded forms, soft depth and smooth feedback carry the playfulness. Decorative imagery and childish ornament do not belong in this world.

This is the approved visual experiment on `ui/playful-observatory`; the former green-neutral world is superseded here and remains on `main`. `src/studio.css`, imported after `src/styles.css`, is authoritative for final styles. Charts and states also draw from `src/components.tsx`, `src/pages.tsx`, `src/Loading.tsx`, `src/Navigation.tsx` and `src/App.tsx`.
keyCharacteristics: Lilac framing, white analytical panels and charcoal anchors.
A coordinated charcoal, lilac, sky and blush KPI strip.
Soft structural shadows and rounded rectangular controls.
Real-request feedback that preserves context and respects motion preferences.

rules.name: The Data Color Rule
rules.body: Use color for series, category, state or measured emphasis. Keep explicit names, units and values alongside it.

dos: **Do** use lilac, blush, sky and charcoal as one coordinated mature palette.
**Do** keep charts, values and readable explanations central to the hierarchy.
**Do** preserve soft depth, measured navigation, mobile value legibility and explicit logarithmic ticks.
**Do** tie loading feedback to real work, label retained data and honor interruption, hidden-document pause and reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** restore the former greenish neutral canvas on this experiment branch.
**Don't** add childish ornament, decorative imagery, heavy shadows or unrelated accent colors.
**Don't** present simulated progress percentages or impose loading delays.
**Don't** leave previous results interactive while a replacement selection is pending.
**Don't** rely on color or motion alone to explain data or state.
